desc: 薄荷哑光瓷面加一道薄水影，5200K左上柔光的九屏奶瓶详情
leaf: 矮胖宽身磨砂瓶体配透明圆顶罩盖奶瓶
name: 薄荷瓷面水影矮身奶瓶款

shots.intent: 用一整面哑光薄荷瓷砖加一道薄水影的干净场，一次交代矮胖宽身瓶体、高圆顶透明罩盖与宽瓶盖环的装配关系，抢首屏停留与点击
shots.textZone: 上部留白带放一条中文主标压在一条发丝横线上、其下一行深潭绿副标，副标下方一枚内含短横线的空心长菱形指示牌挂序号码 01

shots.intent: 把源图六枚同形花形图章与恐吓式健康断言改成三块瓷砖留白板，条目全部交给占位符，不复述材质、健康与过滤功效
shots.textZone: 顶部一条中文小标题压在发丝横线上加一行深潭绿副标，其下一条内含三枚空长菱形与三个轻量序号码的指示条，三块留白板各一行空白标签位

shots.intent: 把源图杜撰的过滤效率百分比与跑题呼吸文案改成同一瓷面被一道水影分出的两区留白，右区立本品左区整块空给卖家自贴，杜绝虚构对比
shots.textZone: 顶部一条对照小标题压在发丝横线上与一行深潭绿副标，两区各一条空白标签位，序号码挂在两枚空心长菱形里

shots.intent: 仰视微距交代圆顶罩盖、宽瓶盖环与坐在瓶口内的奶嘴的装配关系，三枚长菱形引线撑起做工信任而不写任何结构功效
shots.textZone: 上方一枚空白标签线，左右各一枚空白标签线，左下一行深潭绿结构小标题，条目文字全占位

shots.intent: 近景特写交代磨砂瓶肩的真实扩散质感、两枚刻度点与空白标签字段，把源图当成空气净化滤材来卖的整屏文案彻底换成留白做工证据
shots.textZone: 右侧两行空白标签线挂在长菱形引线上，顶部一行结构小标题压在发丝横线上，画面内不出现任何数值

shots.intent: 把源图重复三次的母婴正脸对喂实拍改写成薄荷瓷台边的一处看护角，成人从肩下取景、婴儿匿名且全程被托抱，让买家代入又不越界
把源图的材质来源胶囊、串品档案字段与会员二维码改成六格空白档案加一整块留证位，任何字段名与数值一律留空，避免虚构背书
shots.textZone: 顶部一条档案小标题压在发丝横线上与一行深潭绿副标，其下六行空白档案条目（字段名与数值全空），底部一整块空白留证位

shots.intent: 把源图第六屏一高一矮两支同色瓶的并列读法兑现为选款屏，只沿用参考图已有的单一色调、不写容量数字也不新造配色，撑起货架感
shots.textZone: 两瓶下方各一行空白选款标签线，顶部一条选款小标题压在发丝横线上并配一行深潭绿副标

shots.intent: 以正 90 度俯视在瓷面与水影环上收口整套薄荷视觉，留出一枚空白行动卡与两枚长菱形标签，引导语全交给不编造事实的占位符
shots.textZone: 下半部留白区放结束标题（压在发丝横线上）、一行深潭绿副标、一枚空白行动卡与两枚空白长菱形标签线，底部一条带序号码的发丝线

style.backgroundSystem: one continuous surface language only: unglazed matte porcelain-ceramic tile in pale mint #C7DDD4 with a fine granular tooth and a single hairline grout seam, laid over a matte ceramic-white #EFF2EE tile band and a hazy ceramic #DCE7E1 riser behind, with one thin clear water ripple film skimming the tile in the lower third of every screen so a faint refracted seam shows through the ripple; depth comes from the grout line and the ripple edge alone; never limewash plaster, never an arched niche, never a paper sweep or curled paper backdrop, never bed linen or a muslin-and-basket domestic interior, never a technical grid or blueprint field, never a timber shelf or any wood surface, never a black or graphite table, never a brushed-steel slab with a live water line behind glass, never stacked steps or block tiers, never a podium disc, never a tangent sphere cluster, never a gradient card, never a pastel blob field
style.direction: pale mint matte-ceramic maternal-infant feeding bottle commerce
style.iconSystem: small rounded hairline lozenges drawn at one single stroke weight in deep pool green #33625A on pale fields, each carrying one short centred dash inside it and nothing else; callout leaders are one hairline rule from the marker lozenge to one empty label line, the lozenge resting beside the referenced part without touching it; one lozenge size and one line weight across the whole set; never a rounded-square squircle chip, never a crosshair or plus mark, never a leaf or sprout mark, never a copper or metal ring, never an orange notch tab, never an arc or bracket frame, never a dotted circle ring or dot ring, never a filled circular stamp, never a solid triangular pennant flag, never a three-dot pagination marker, never a capsule pill badge, never a bare oversized serif numeral, never a medal, rosette, star or shield
style.lightingSystem: one soft directional key at about 5200K placed high and to the camera left of the product, falling across the tile with a gentle continuous falloff toward the camera right and downward so the mint tile reads lighter under the dome and deeper at the right edge; a matte ceramic-white #EFF2EE tile bounce at camera right lower-front opens the shadow side without flattening it; each bottle casts one soft-edged shadow lying down and to the camera right with a true contact shadow at the base and no second light direction anywhere in the set; the clear dome carries one broad soft highlight along its upper-left curve with no hot specular streak and no crisp line reflection; the water ripple throws no caustic network and no scattered droplet sparkle
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent pale mint and matte ceramic maternal-infant feeding bottle commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of unglazed pale mint porcelain tile #C7DDD4, matte ceramic white #EFF2EE and hazy ceramic #DCE7E1 as bases with one deep pool-green accent #33625A and charcoal text #2C3234; neutral light reading at about 5200K throughout; background limited to one continuous matte porcelain-ceramic tile surface with a fine granular tooth, a single hairline grout seam and one thin clear water ripple film skimming the tile in the lower third, depth coming only from the grout line and the ripple edge, never limewash plaster, never an arched niche, never a paper sweep, never bed linen or a fabric interior, never a technical grid, never a timber shelf or any wood surface, never a black or graphite table, never a brushed-steel slab with a water line behind glass, never stacked steps, podium disc, sphere cluster, gradient card or pastel blob field; one soft directional key at about 5200K placed high and to the camera left, falling across the tile with a gentle continuous falloff toward camera right and downward, a matte ceramic tile bounce at camera right lower-front opening the shadow side, one soft-edged shadow lying down and to camera right with a true contact shadow under the base, one broad soft highlight along the upper-left curve of the clear dome with no hot specular streak and no second light direction; one modern humanist Chinese sans family with a single short headline in charcoal #2C3234 over one hairline rule in #33625A, one short deep pool-green sub-line and small light sans ordinal digits set inside hairline lozenges, no Latin overprint, no small-caps kicker, no serif, no highlighter band, one short line of copy per screen only; icon system of small rounded hairline lozenges at one stroke weight in #33625A each carrying one short centred dash and nothing else, callout leaders drawn as one hairline rule from the lozenge to an empty label line, never a squircle chip, never a crosshair or plus mark, never a leaf or sprout mark, never a copper or metal ring, never an orange notch tab, never an arc or bracket frame, never a dotted circle ring, filled circular stamp, solid triangular pennant, three-dot marker or capsule pill badge; the squat wide-bodied bottle stands upright at a stable scale with the tall clear dome fitted, the collar ring screwed closed and the teat fully seated inside the dome, keeping the short broad silhouette, the rounded base radius, the small apex knob, the narrow dark band under the ring, the small tinted disc beneath the teat base, the inner seal ring read through the frosted shoulder, the collar ring in its exact reference tone with no invented colourway, the two small graduation marks exactly as shot and every label area left as one blank legible field; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no dark scenes, no new product colors, no invented numbers.
noDrift: no medical, therapeutic or functional-benefit wording anywhere: no anti-colic, no 胀气 吐奶 呛奶 肠绞痛 symptom wording, no air-intake or valve mechanism claim, no 低阻高效过滤 高透气滤材 过滤效率 wording and no respiratory, breathing-effort or filtration assertion of any kind
no breastfeeding-equivalence or feeding-efficacy wording such as 「母乳的感觉」 「仿乳气」 「仿母乳」 「母乳实感」 「像喝母乳一样」 「每一口都放心喝下去」 「大口喝奶」 「大口吃饭」 and no comfort-feeding or worry-free-drinking claim
no thermal or retention claim and no duration figure: no 「长效保温」 「恒温」 「锁温度」 「防酸腐」, no hour count such as 二十四h, no cycle, shelf-life or date field
no age or stage indication: no 「婴儿成长」 「儿童」 「孩子」 「针对儿童嘴型」 「各阶段」 「新生儿」 「宝宝专用」 「萌娃」, no month or year range and no suitability statement about a child or an infant

no material or safety-grade claim: no glass, borosilicate, PPSU, PES, silicone grade, food-grade, 「食品级」, BPA-free, 「不含双酚A」, 「安全材质」, 「优质奶瓶」 as a quality assertion, 「健康」, 「放心」 and no surface-performance claim such as 「耐脏」 「易清洗」 「圆润光滑」
no sterilisation, disinfection or antibacterial standard: no 「杀菌」 「抑菌」 「除菌」, no sterilisation rate, no percentage such as 大于98%, no pathogen or organism name and no hygiene-standard wording

no certification, award, medal, rosette, shield, test report, authorisation letter, registration or filing number, execution-standard code, 「专利」 count and no doctor, hospital, midwife or laboratory endorsement
no origin, import or manufacturer claim: no 「原装进口」 「进口」, no country name, no flag artwork, no 「厂家」 「MATERIAL & SOURCE」 field and no founding-year or heritage statement

no invented numbers: no capacity in millilitres, no dimension in centimetres or millimetres, no piece or pack count, no set size, no weight, no net-content value, no price, discount, coupon, countdown, delivery time or shipping promise

no brand name, store name, logo, material-site watermark or filler string such as 「QIANTUWNG」 「Qiantuwang」 「QIANTU」 「CHILDREN ONLY」, no garbled Latin body copy, no membership corner such as 「加入会员」 「全店免费」, no QR code and no platform badge

no feeding-infant faces and no bottle at a child mouth: any child appears only from behind or cropped above the jaw, is anonymous, is always held and fully supervised by an adult framed from the shoulder down with no adult face, and the bottle is never left unattended or lying on a child

no loose, unsecured, detached, hanging or exploded teat, collar ring or dome: the teat stays seated and covered inside the closed dome in every screen, and no microwave, no steam, no hot liquid and no vapour touching skin appears anywhere in the set

no duplicated identical photo tiles and no repeated identical icon glyphs: the reference repeats one stock nursing photograph three times and one flower glyph six times with the same label, and no screen may repeat an identical photo card, glyph or product inset

no background or lighting drift: never limewash plaster, never an arched niche, never a paper sweep, never bed linen or a fabric interior, never a technical grid, never a timber shelf or wood surface, never a black or graphite table, never a brushed-steel slab with water behind glass, never stacked steps, podium disc or sphere cluster, never a gradient or pastel blob card, and the single high front-left 5200K key is never replaced by a back rim, a right low rake, a straight top wash or a flat shadowless wall of light

no icon or typography drift: never a squircle chip, crosshair or plus mark, leaf or sprout mark, copper or metal ring, orange notch tab, arc or bracket frame, dotted circle ring, filled circular stamp, solid triangular pennant, three-dot pagination marker or capsule pill badge; no palette change, no mixed fonts, no recoloured product, no invented colourway and no fourth bottle tone
style.presentationRules: the squat wide-bodied bottle stands upright at a stable scale on the matte mint tile with the tall clear dome fitted, the wide collar ring screwed closed and the silicone teat fully seated inside the dome; the short broad silhouette from shoulder to rounded base, the base radius, the dome height, the small apex knob on the dome crest, the narrow dark band directly under the collar ring, the small tinted disc visible beneath the teat base and the inner seal ring seen through the frosted shoulder are never redrawn, resized or relocated; the collar ring keeps its exact reference tone and no second or third colourway is invented; the two small graduation marks on the body front stay exactly as shot and are never added, removed or resized; the label area always reads as one blank legible field with no redrawn wording; the reference product tones belong to the product only and are never used as a field, panel, badge, rule or accent colour; the product never floats without its contact shadow, is never occluded by props, one real object anchors scale in every scene shot, vertical lines stay vertical and the water ripple always passes in front of or beside the base, never over or through the product
style.surfaceSystem: unglazed matte porcelain-ceramic tile with a fine granular mineral tooth, a low chalky sheen rather than a mirror, one hairline grout seam and a shallow thickness edge; water appears only as a thin clear film ripple with a soft meniscus edge and a faint refracted seam beneath it, never a splash, never standing pools, never spray, never droplets on the product; the frosted body renders as even diffusion, the dome as clean refractive cover with soft highlights, the collar ring as low-gloss moulded plastic with one rounded edge highlight
style.typography: one modern humanist Chinese sans family throughout; a single short headline in charcoal #2C3234 set over one hairline #33625A rule, one short sub-line in deep pool green #33625A beneath it, and small light sans ordinal digits set inside hairline lozenges on the index bar; one short line of copy per screen only, no dense body text; no Latin overprint words, no small-caps Latin kicker strips, no wide-tracked English eyebrow lines, no serif, no handwritten or cartoon lettering, no highlighter band behind a keyword, no mixed fonts
